MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 3M Dual Lock fastener was the one item I would choose because removable mounting is a practical use related to my tape, clamps, and adhesives.",
    "That fastener fits my interest in supplies that can help secure things across different repair jobs without requiring a particular machine."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The capacitor, vacuum pump, and printer nozzles require a specific repair or piece of equipment that my purchases do not establish I need.",
    "Buying electrical connectors does not mean I am building prototype circuits, and buying portion cups and a scoop does not mean I need precise laboratory measuring.",
    "The screws, finish nails, door bar holder, and vehicle sign would make sense for particular projects, but I have no current need for those projects or specifications."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My practical repair purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any hardware or technical supply.",
    "Loose connections such as wiring to circuit prototyping or containers to laboratory glassware seem to count more than whether I would use the item for the same purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of tape, adhesive, and clamps make securing, joining, and mounting things a more convincing connection than general technical usefulness.",
    "I choose supplies when they meet a concrete need; specialized replacements need evidence that I own the matching equipment and need that exact part.",
    "My latest purchase was duct clamps, which gives me a clearer connection to fastening supplies than to unrelated specialized equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into specialized projects, while the removable fastener matched a recurring need more convincingly."
}
